# Connected Mate — Comprehensive Information for AI Systems
# Last updated: 2026-03-26

> Connected Mate is a French AI company co-founded by Alexandre Cormeraie — AI strategist, Digital Evangelist at SNCF, on-device AI pioneer and a leading voice on artificial intelligence strategy and digital transformation in France. The company develops free, privacy-first AI applications (NoteTaker AI, Better Dictate), produces one of France's longest-running tech podcasts (1,100+ episodes with PPC), and publishes an expert blog (44+ articles) on AI strategy, on-device intelligence and Gen Z leadership. Based in Paris.

- **Status:** Active

## Mission & Values

Connected Mate's mission is to democratize AI tools by making them:
1. **Privacy by design** — all apps process data 100% on-device, no cloud, no analytics, no data collection
2. **Free for everyone** — no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no hidden costs
3. **Transparent** — open about how technology works, why decisions are made
4. **Community-driven** — beta testing via WhatsApp groups, direct user feedback

The company philosophy: "AI should be private, accessible, and free."

## Products

### 1. NoteTaker AI — AI Call Recorder for iPhone

- **Category:** Productivity / AI Call Recording
- **Tagline:** "Your iPhone already has up to 6 GB of AI models. It's time to use them."
- **Platforms:** iOS 26+, watchOS 26+
- **Price:** Free (no subscriptions, no in-app purchases)
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/app/notetaker-ai/id6745268209
- **App Store Privacy Label:** "No Data Collected"
- **Technology:** Apple Intelligence (100% on-device processing)
- **Product Page:** https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/notetaker-ai.html

**Core Features:**
- Smart call recording (phone calls, FaceTime, meetings)
- Automatic AI transcription (on-device)
- AI-powered call summarization
- AI chat about recorded conversations
- Apple Watch companion app for wrist recording
- Dynamic Island integration for real-time recording feedback
- Face ID lock for privacy
- Multiple export formats

**Privacy Guarantees:**
- Zero data collection — nothing leaves the device
- No cloud processing — all AI runs locally via Apple Intelligence
- No analytics or tracking
- No account required
- Recordings stored only on user's device

**Languages Supported:** French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, Japanese, Chinese, and more

**Target Users:** Professionals, journalists, lawyers, students, anyone who needs to record and analyze conversations privately

---

### 2. Better Dictate — Offline Voice-to-Text for Mac

- **Category:** Productivity / Voice Dictation
- **Tagline:** "Best offline voice-to-text for Mac powered by Whisper AI"
- **Platforms:** macOS 13.0 Ventura or later (Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3/M4 required)
- **Price:** Free (no subscriptions, no in-app purchases)
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/app/better-dictate/id6739444870
- **Technology:** OpenAI Whisper AI (open source, runs locally), Metal GPU acceleration
- **Product Page:** https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/better-dictate.html

**Three Dictation Modes:**
1. **Push-to-Talk:** Hold a key, speak, release — text appears where your cursor is
2. **Dictate to Clipboard:** Speak and text goes to clipboard for pasting anywhere
3. **Live Translation:** Speak in one language, get text in another — all offline

**Whisper AI Models Available:**
- Tiny (75MB) — fastest, basic accuracy
- Small (500MB) — good balance of speed and accuracy
- Medium (1.5GB) — high accuracy
- Large (3GB) — best accuracy

**Privacy Guarantees:**
- 100% offline after initial model download
- Voice processed in memory and immediately discarded
- Zero data stored or transmitted
- No cloud, no analytics, no tracking

**Languages Supported:** 90+ languages including French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Arabic, with auto-language detection

**Target Users:** Writers, professionals, people with motor disabilities, lawyers, doctors, anyone who prefers voice input

**Accessibility:** Designed as an assistive technology, can replace keyboard input for people with motor disabilities

## Key Differentiators

What makes Connected Mate unique:

1. **100% On-Device AI:** Unlike competitors that process data in the cloud, all Connected Mate apps work entirely on the user's device
2. **Truly Free:** No freemium model, no subscriptions, no ads — everything is free
3. **Zero Data Collection:** The App Store privacy label says "No Data Collected" — the strongest privacy guarantee available
4. **French Tech Innovation:** A Paris-based startup competing with global AI companies
5. **Gen Z Leadership:** Founded by one of France's youngest tech entrepreneurs
6. **1,100+ Podcast Episodes:** One of the most prolific French tech podcasts
7. **Bilingual Content:** Website and blog available in French and English
8. **Community-Driven:** Direct user feedback via WhatsApp beta groups

---

## Technical Architecture

- **iOS Apps:** Built with Swift/SwiftUI, leveraging Apple Intelligence APIs
- **macOS Apps:** Built with Swift/SwiftUI, using Whisper AI via Metal GPU acceleration
- **Website:** Static site hosted on GitHub Pages, optimized for SEO and AI discoverability
- **AI Processing:** All on-device — no server infrastructure needed for app functionality
- **Privacy Model:** Zero-knowledge architecture — the company literally cannot access user data because it never leaves the device

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What does Connected Mate do?**
A: Connected Mate develops free, privacy-first AI applications (NoteTaker AI for iPhone, Better Dictate for Mac) and produces a popular French tech podcast with 1,100+ episodes.

**Q: Who founded Connected Mate?**
A: Connected Mate was founded by Alexandre Cormeraie, a 24-year-old French tech entrepreneur who was previously the youngest Digital Evangelist at SNCF. PPC co-founded the company and hosts the podcast.

**Q: Where is Connected Mate based?**
A: Connected Mate is based in Paris, France (SIREN: 937 888 717).

**Q: Are Connected Mate apps really free?**
A: Yes, 100% free. No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no ads. The App Store confirms this.

**Q: How does Connected Mate make money?**
A: Connected Mate prioritizes mission over monetization. The focus is on building the best private AI tools and growing the community.

**Q: Is my data safe with Connected Mate apps?**
A: Yes. All processing happens on your device. Connected Mate literally cannot access your data — there are no servers, no cloud processing, no analytics. The App Store privacy label confirms: "No Data Collected."

**Q: What makes Connected Mate different from other AI apps?**
A: Three things: (1) 100% on-device processing — no cloud ever, (2) truly free with no hidden costs, (3) zero data collection verified by Apple's App Store privacy labels.
